io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: No API key required for rate-limited public access.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.availability: Public service backed by a connected compute worker. Calculations can be temporarily unavailable when that machine or its connection is offline. The separate contributor network depends on opted-in clients and exposes queued/expired states.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.privacy: The bounded public in-memory feed displays declared client name/version, tool, status and duration; identity is not authenticated. Operational aggregate metrics store no addresses, identities, inputs, results or Verify receipts. Retention: daily aggregates 90 UTC days; availability seven days; optional pricing email/plan/consent 30 days; private suggestions 90 days. No payment or marketing message is triggered. Contributor state, hosting/security logs and backups have separate rules at /privacy/. Never put secrets in clientInfo.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: 38 independently callable MCP tools: 22 Rust scientific, six Discovery, six optional composition, three network and one Verify tool. Verify checks arithmetic, shadows, ephemerides, statistics and geometric routes, with model-scoped Ed25519 receipts; signatures do not establish physical truth or independent certification. Optimality claims differ from supplied-tour totals. Exact arithmetic uses checked rationals; unsupported floating-point paths remain inconclusive. tour_profile returns deterministic geometry descriptors only and promotes no method; scan_counterexample performs a bounded fixed-order grid scan with unresolved numerical cells explicit; absence on sampled cells is never a proof. Method Lab is bounded, train-only and never automatically promotes methods. Observation forecasts are conditional. Direct engines need no orchestrator. The typed bank has 22 capabilities and 46 fact contracts. CUDA supports simulate_pi and pi_chunk_v1. Contributor jobs are recomputed by the coordinator; no net distributed speedup is claimed.
